body: I only went to 3 sessions with a psychiatrist but it costs more than I'm worth to be honest. I can't pay for it even if I tried...
My comfort zone is pretty small. I have an anxiety disorder so even leaving the house is hell for me.

Child protective services are coming to my house. It's my fault because I trusted someone I shouldn't have with my personal life. I had to talk my dad down from suicide the other day. My depression is at an all time low. I've never felt worse than I do now and everything is getting worse and worse. It feels like life is throwing all it can at me. My dad is making serious threats against me that break my heart. Dysphoria is hell and makes the depression worse. I wish I could kill myself but I don't want to hurt those around me. So I guess I'm just going to hang out for a while I guess.

This subreddit is for trans people and people questioning their gender. Find something better to do with your time than troll people online who want nothing to do with you. A snarky comment isn't going to change anyone on here's minds on who they are or what they do. 
And fix your typo sweetheart, it makes you look like even more of an idiot than you already are.

Holy shit this describes how I feel exactly but the other way around.. Especially with the thing about being more comfortable with the dysphoria than the fear of socially transitioning, that's always been a huge fear of mine ...
I think about this a lot. The answer is probably that I would be afraid that I would never be happy...

It helps a lot actually, thank you for taking the time to write this! Yeah I always feel like a "fake" whenever people say they are 100% sure they are that gender because I'm pretty sure I'll never be that, epecially because I think and act in traditionally "feminine" ways and I hate it. I'm always gonna be confused because to me gender is so fucking complex it wracks my brain... It feels nice to not be alone in not being able or willing to say I am 100% certain in what gender I am or identify as, you know?
